reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative:
This project responds to two objectives:
1) Diminishing the Non-Performing Loans (NPLs) and arrears precipitated by the warfare in the Gaza Strip with its consequential impact on economic activity. This should be achieved by helping Faten offer a debt restructuring mechanism to its end-borrowers to cope with financial distress.
2) Contributing to retaining MSME jobs. We foresee that approximately 200 MSMEs will benefit from an interest payment relief of three months. Hence, Palestinian MSMEs undergoing financial stress will be able to redirect debt service payments to salaries, retain the staff on the payroll, and focus on business continuity.
